findings.evidence: `variable {A B : Type*}` at Matching.lean:87, no `Fintype A` anywhere in the file; `Matrix.rank` requires `[Fintype n]` only (upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Rank.lean:131-134); TauCeti's `rank_eq_card_iff_mulVec_injective` docstring states "The row index type need not be finite" (upstream/TauCeti/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Rank.lean:40-43).
findings.fix: Say "an explicit matrix with finitely many columns" (or "a matrix whose columns are the finitely many operators of each total degree"); optionally note that the amplitude index need not be finite.
findings.issue: Module docstring says uniqueness holds "exactly when an explicit finite matrix has full column rank". `matchingMatrix M k : Matrix A (P.totalDegreePiece k) ℝ` has rows indexed by an arbitrary `A : Type*` (line 87, no finiteness hypothesis); only its columns are finite. Calling it finite misstates the generality of the result.

findings.evidence: `effectiveAmplitude_eq_sum_range` (line 122): `= ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), ε ^ k • ∑ o ∈ P.totalDegreePiece k, c o * M o`; the lemma statement at line 184 contains no `n`.
findings.fix: Qualify with "when `k ≤ n`", or state the lemma's meaning without reference to `effectiveAmplitude` (the sum of `c o * M a o` over the operators of total degree `k`).
findings.issue: `matchingMatrix_mulVec_apply`'s docstring claims the `mulVec` "gives, for each amplitude, the coefficient of `ε ^ k` in the effective-theory amplitude". That holds only for `k ≤ n`: `effectiveAmplitude n` expands over `range (n + 1)` and has no `ε ^ k` term for `k > n`, while the `mulVec` is generally nonzero there.

summary: Documentation is otherwise accurate and well-scoped (every public definition and main theorem documented, no process narrative, upstream comparisons verified), but the module docstring misdescribes the matching matrix as finite when its row index type is arbitrary, and one lemma docstring drops the `k ≤ n` restriction it needs.
